t: Nix Flakes & Magic Cookies: Building a Self-Updating Dev Environment
s: This article details the process of creating a simplified, one-command development environment for the Pipulate project using Nix Flakes. It focuses on automating setup, service startup, and browser tab management, while also exploring a 'magic cookie' system for self-updating.
